name: ColorBox
summary: Free browser tool that builds accessible OKLCH/OKLAB color palettes and scales with tunable hue, saturation and lightness curves.
description: Generate perceptually uniform color systems in the browser: pick a seed color, tune bezier curves for hue, saturation and luminosity, and watch real-time WCAG 2.1 contrast feedback on every step of the scale. Export to CSS, Tailwind, Figma tokens or JSON; works standalone or as a Figma plugin. Built for Lyft, now free for everyone.
contains: customizable hue, saturation and luminosity curves
real-time WCAG 2.1 contrast checking with 3:1 and 4.5:1 markers
export: CSS, Tailwind, Figma tokens, JSON
standalone web app or Figma plugin
free forever, no account needed; built for Lyft
